title: Fault Triage Runbook & Payload-diff Viewer (prototype)
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Design a lightweight, action-oriented Fault Triage Runbook panel paired with a Payload-diff Viewer for the Redwood Console. Goal: reduce mean time to resolution for failed requests by giving engineers a concise relationship between error taxonomy, retry behavior, rollout/canary state, and exact payload differences across retries and model variants. The component will live on the Request Details page and be surfaced in the new Diagnostics Dashboard. Focus areas: 1) surfacing an error signature + root cause hints; 2) an interactive payload diff (with sensitive-field redaction and smart token alignment for LLM inputs/outputs); 3) runbook steps that are contextual (links to logs, recent rollouts, model variant changes, and suggested rerun steps); 4) show cost delta per failure to help prioritize triage. Prototype should be clickable in Figma and validated with PM/Eng/Support.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook panel shows top error signatures for a request and one-line remediation hints
Payload-diff viewer displays side-by-side request and response deltas with token-aligned highlights and redaction markers
Canary/rollout correlation row shows percentage of errors in active canaries and links to rollout history
Triage steps include actionable links: Open logs (Grafana), open GitHub PRs for recent model changes, trigger a retry with preserved KV cache
Prototype receives approval from PM and two engineering reviewers during design review
UX performance: initial render within the Request Details panel under 150ms in prototype (mocked data)
decisions: Keep the runbook scope narrow: start with 'Failed Tokenization', 'KV-cache-miss', 'Model OOM', 'RateLimited' as first-class signatures
Implement payload-diff at token-granularity for LLM inputs and JSON-field granular diffs for structured payloads
Redaction: default to automatic PII redaction and surface an 'unredact' request action that audits access via KMS logs
Defer deep replay/simulation tooling to a follow-up ticket; initial retry button will call existing retry endpoint with preserved headers
next_steps: Sync with ENG runtime on token-aligned diff algorithm (scheduled 2026-03-12)
Hand off Figma prototype to UX engineering with annotated specs by 2026-03-15
Run PM/Support usability session and record 6 transcripts (target completion 2026-03-18)
Create ENG ticket for telemetry events required for canary correlation (suggested labels: telemetry, diagnostics)
